verdict.rationale: Community reports indicate DeepSeek's models ship as open weights that can run locally: the V4 Flash native-precision weights total about 154 GB and are described as "very accessible for people running large local models". Commenters also describe the releases as open-source and mention a distilled Llama 8B variant. All of the first-party docs cover only the hosted API, so self-hosting rests on community evidence alone. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of weight downloads and licensing, an official self-hosting or deployment guide, and hands-on confirmation that self-hosted capability matches the hosted product.
